E: coded 2026-09 as borderline E(i) (independent Vals trajectory audit shows git-query solution lookup across all 6 audited frontier models; Vals also archived the benchmark: 'Since performance on this benchmark has saturated, we no longer run this benchmark on new model releases'). Not coded as E: 'The SWE-Bench Illusion' (arXiv 2506.12286, v1 2025-06-14) - only 'possible data contamination' from file-path identification (up to 76% vs 53%), labs kept reporting; flag for adjudication since it would move primary date to 2025-06 if accepted. 2025-11-18 swebench experiments policy limited Verified/Multilingual submissions to academic/research teams (not a freeze). Primary = C 2026-02 (earlier than AB 2026-04).
